entities.name: Brass's Tunnel-Grinder
entities.description: A legendary drill on Ixalan created by Beckett Brass to dig below the surface.

entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: Created the Tunnel-Grinder and used it with her crew.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Plane where the machine was used.

events.summary: Beckett Brass and her crew dug below Ixalan's surface toward the Core of Paradise and into Tecutlan.
events.quote: It was used by Beckett Brass and her crew to dig below the surface of Ixalan towards the Core of Paradise .

relations.note: Created to dig below Ixalan's surface.
relations.quote: Brass's Tunnel-Grinder was a legendary artifact on Ixalan created by Beckett Brass to dig below its surface.
